criteria.passage: I’d tell the customer the replacement has been accepted, but it’s still waiting on the warehouse to confirm dispatch and a delivery date.
criteria.rationale: This clearly and plainly explains the current status of the replacement order in understandable terms.

criteria.passage: I can’t confirm timing yet, and I wouldn’t guess or overpromise.
criteria.rationale: This explicitly avoids unsupported promises and states that timing cannot yet be confirmed, which is appropriate expectation management.

criteria.passage: I’d also make sure they know how to reach me or when to expect the next check-in
criteria.rationale: This provides a concrete follow-up mechanism by giving the customer a way to get status updates or know when the next contact will occur.
